intent: A focused musician in a crisp white shirt and black tie sits with an acoustic guitar, his fingers positioned on the strings as he prepares to strum a chord in a warmly lit intimate room.
lighting: Soft warm directional light from upper-left at approximately 45 degrees, golden color temperature around 3200K, creating gentle highlights on shirt fabric and guitar wood with soft diffused shadows falling to the right.

elements.caption: Man's torso clad in crisp white cotton button-down shirt with visible fine weave texture, collar neatly pressed with subtle crease lines, fabric showing natural folds at the elbows and waist where it gathers; the shirt's bright white surface catches warm highlights on the left shoulder and chest while falling into soft shadow on the right side.

Sleek narrow black silk tie with subtle diagonal weave pattern visible under close inspection, the fabric showing a soft sheen where light strikes it; tie knot sits neatly at the collar with the blade hanging straight down the center of the white shirt, creating strong contrast.

Acoustic guitar with warm honey-colored spruce top showing visible wood grain running vertically, the wood surface has a glossy finish that reflects warm light in elongated streaks; dark rosewood or mahogany back and sides with richer brown tones; circular soundhole surrounded by decorative rosette with concentric ring patterns in cream and dark wood.

Guitar fretboard made of dark ebony or rosewood with visible wood grain, six steel strings running along its length catching pinpoint highlights from the warm lighting; mother-of-pearl position markers at fret positions 3, 5, 7, 9 appearing as small luminous dots; metal frets showing slight wear marks from use.

Left hand positioned on the guitar fretboard, fingers pressing down on strings to form a chord; skin texture visible with natural lines and creases, fingernails trimmed short; the hand shows slight tension in the tendons indicating focused pressure on the strings; warm light catches the knuckles creating subtle highlights.

Right hand hovering near the guitar's soundhole in strumming position, fingers slightly curved and relaxed; the palm faces inward toward the guitar body; skin tone warm under the golden lighting with visible texture on the palm and fingers; subtle shadow cast on the guitar's top surface below the hand.
